about: LISTFIX3 draft owner decisions (2026-11-11): for the coordinator to fold into docs/decisions.json. Each body and its options under 100 words.

items.title: New first-clear rewards for four fights
items.body: 5-2 paid Sphagnum Vole, a card you cut; it now pays Raft Spider, your Map 5 Yes card nearest it (Common, 1 Lumber, Wait 1, 3/8), already in 5-2's deck. No other Cure card is on your Map 5 picks (CONTENT3 C1 wanted one). Three rewards were off their map's new list (a first-clear card must be on it, GD-5): 1-4 Field Mouse -> Bramble Sprout, 7-2 Dung Beetle -> Fungus Gnat Cloud, 10-5 Kraken Spawnling -> Sea Bass.

items.title: Cards that left play with your Map cards picks
items.body: These 17 were on a list before SKIR1 and are on none now, so no pack, fight or reward gives them: Raven Scout, Alpha Howler, Pelican Diver, Frost Hare Sprinter, Tidepool Trapper Crab, Lunar Howler, Lion's Mane Jelly, Supernova Jelly, Spitting Spider, Weaver Bird, Water Vole, Woodcock Lookout, Marsh Harrier, Cane Toad, Badger Stonemason, Prospector Mole, Nudibranch. The two jellyfish were your CONTENT7-1 wish.
options: b) Name the ones to place, and where.
